messages:
Sam: evening warmup — quick async standup. TL;DR: landed kernel slot-fix + microbatch fallback. Blocker: flaky KV evict test failing in CI. Today: run perf sweep on 2 GPUs and try to repro flaky test.

Maya: nice. can you paste the failing test log? i can try a repro locally. also did you bump the batcher timeout?

Sam: log excerpt below
```text
E 03/17 19:02:11 kv_cache.cpp:423 Evict: inconsistency detected: ref_count -1
Stack: 0x7f9a3b2c ...
```
Might be a race on refcount decrement after async free. batcher timeout is still 100ms.

Arin: FYI i saw something similar on canary yesterday when slot steal overlapped heavy prefix cache churn. could be kv eviction + prefetch overlap. i can add instrumentation to emit evict latency histograms.

Sam: thanks Arin — that would help. For the perf sweep i'm running:
1) microbatch = 16 / 32
2) kv_prefetch = true / false
3) batch_timeout = 50ms / 100ms
Will post results here.

Lee: ping on PR #4823 — kernel: fix async free. needs one more review. small change. @Sam mind a quick look? i'm offsite but can merge after your ack.

Sam: looking now. quick note: test failure seems unrelated to that PR but i'll shout if i see overlap.

Pat: ops note — reduced canary traffic by 30% to reduce bench noise. if you need more isolation ping me. also bumped bench retention to 72h.

Maya: repro steps i ran locally (devbox):
```bash
./tools/run_kv_stress --workers=12 --warmup=30s
python perf/sweep.py --microbatch 16,32 --kv_prefetch true,false
```
I hit one evict fail after warmup when workers spiked.

Sam: uploaded raw bench CSV: gs://redwood-perf/sam/1768182930-warmup-sweep.csv

Arin: i'll add evict latency hist to /metrics/evict_latency and drop a tracepoint at kv_free_async. should help pinpoint ordering.

Lee: approved PR #4823. merging in ~10m. if the flake persists after merge we should consider a short gc grace window before evict (e.g., grace=50ms).

Sam: ack. i'll rerun the sweep after merge and with grace=50ms. thanks all :thumbsup:
